Read in a set of data files and store them in a list

Source: R/readin_datalist.R
readin_datalist.Rd

Reads all of the .csv files in a folder (or chosen ones) into a list of data.tables, named after the files. It reverses saveout_datalist().

Usage

readin_datalist(
  folder = "processed",
  flist = NULL,
  data = list(),
  drp = F,
  token = NULL
)

Arguments

folder

Folder (or vector of folders) to read from. Default is "processed". If it does not exist, you will be asked to choose one.

flist

Names of the files to read (including .csv). Default is all of the files in the folder.

data

An existing list to add the data to.

drp

Read the files from a dropbox folder? This needs the rdrop2 package.

token

The dropbox token, if using drp.

Value

A list of data.tables, named after the files (without .csv).

Details

If a list is given in data that already has an item with the same name as a file, the new data is added to the bottom of the existing item. This is useful for adding more participants.

See also

saveout_datalist()
